facts.fact_text: The applicant, together with a number of other members of the Popular Front Party of Azerbaijan, was arrested during the dispersal of an unauthorised demonstration held on 23 November 2006.
On 23 November 2006, the Sabail District Court convicted the applicant under Article 310.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences, relying on the related administrative offence report.
